pyramiding_rule: Never pyramid into falling knives; only scale into positions showing an established momentum slope greater than 3 ticks per second with zero negative tick feedback.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based buffer zone of at least 1.5x the 5-period noise candle applied to all initial stop-losses to prevent micro-wick hunting.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing or partial harvest whenever unrealized profit crosses the +$12.00 threshold to protect against evaporation.
